description: This file defines a data structure for buffer protection metadata used in media processing, along with a function declaration for processing this metadata, specifically in the context of GStreamer multimedia framework.

classes.name: BufferProtectionMetadata
classes.description: A structure holding metadata related to media buffer encryption, including encryption status, key IDs, initialization vectors, subsample information, and encryption scheme details.

methods.name: ProcessProtectionMetadata
methods.description: A function to process GStreamer buffers and populate BufferProtectionMetadata with protection-related information.
